GUEST.HERO_SUBTITLE: An educational cybersecurity app built around interactive scenarios and digital investigations.
GUEST.ABOUT_TEXT: A digital security simulator. You inspect suspicious emails, phishing links, spoofed sites, QR codes, and public Wi-Fi networks to identify threats and protect yourself online.
GUEST.AUDIENCE_TEXT: Designed for teens aged 15+, students, and adults — both with and without IT backgrounds. Clear, accurate explanations with a light, humorous tone.
GUEST.START_TEXT: Sign up or log in to save your progress, unlock advanced tiers, and earn badges. Or jump straight into practice!
